messages:
sophie: Quick thought: add a short-lived 'undo token' issued at commit time + an optional preview mode that can shadow a tiny sample. Helps fast rollback from bad telemetry.

jamal: Sounds useful. How would the token work?

sophie: Server signs a blob with commit_id + changes_hash + exp. POST /configs/apply?request_undo=true returns undo_token. Revert: POST /configs/revert {undo_token}.

meera: Preview needs to be realistic: pin model/version, route through same batching/cache, and flag telemetry so it doesn't pollute prod metrics.

alex: Security: tokens must be scoped (org/team), audited, and KMS-signed. Issuance and use should create audit traces.

sophie: UX: console shows a countdown for undo TTL, sim_metrics (cost delta, p95 delta, error delta), and 1-click revert while token valid. Also optional auto-revert policy based on telemetry gates.

jamal: Edge-case: overlapping commits. Undo should be defined as "revert this commit id" and documented as best-effort if later commits depend on it.

opsbot: deploy-bot: preview-simulator v1.0 rolled to staging 2026-02-12T09:10:00Z :white_check_mark:
